profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with a passion for solving real-world problems. Experienced in full-stack development and database design. Familiar with C#, TypeScript, Rust, Python, and databases, including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed secure authentication system with JWTs and session management, protecting employee accounts and enforcing security policies across distributed systems
• Automated service deployment with docker and GitHub actions, saves 30 minutes per deployment
• Built internal ticketing system with Node.js, React, TypeScript, and MongoDB, for 1500 employees
• Automated time usage studies with AI, saving 300 hours per week
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering · Next.js · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed internal production tracking system; can track instrument production, servicing, and components. Estimated to save over 25 hours per week for the production team
• Applied same tech stack to develop internal training system, tracking employee training in production processes, material handling, and legal requirements to ensure ISO compliance
• Built online RMA system to streamline repair and certification process and ensure RMA data integrity
• Developed remote sound level meter access system with proxy for HTTP access
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · REST APIs · ASP.NET · SQL · C# · User Experience Design (UED) · Blazor

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: • Built a beehive tracker using the RAK4200 and AWS Lambda functions to monitor beehive health and notify owners of beehive movement
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Cloud Infrastructure · AWS Lambda · JavaScript

positions.title: Business Intern
positions.description: • Designed coursework to train new business owners in Ecuador in principles of accounting, finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship, servicing 30 people per month
